extras: Unofficial fan project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Chronoverse Games Studio.
intentEvidence: ChronoVault is an Obsidian plugin for ChronoCCG.
motivation: The author wanted to keep their decks and tournament reports in their vault using real cards instead of plain text.
problem: Users need a way to keep complex, game-specific data like card lists, deck compositions, and tournament reports directly within their Obsidian vault using real card representations instead of plain text.
summary: ChronoVault is an Obsidian plugin that allows users to manage ChronoCCG cards, build and validate decks, and document tournament results within their vault.
